knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic marketing records
knowledge.detail: Fixed segment, campaign, content, test, conversion, revenue, and engagement records support deterministic planning reviews.

knowledge.name: Marketing rules and safety knowledge
knowledge.detail: Uploaded guidance defines approved personas, aggregate-only analysis, evidence anchors, approval gates, and prohibited actions.

knowledge.name: Approved solution architecture
knowledge.detail: The curated package identifies Dynamics 365 and Teams as governed seams; it does not claim configured live connections.

intelligence_processing.name: Aggregate customer segment analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic commercial behavior, value, engagement, and churn signals without identifying people or using demographics.

intelligence_processing.name: Review-only campaign concept design
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds multi-stage campaign concepts, draft sequences, assumptions, benchmarks, and approval gates without launching them.

intelligence_processing.name: Privacy-safe content personalization
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts segment-level hero copy and product ideas from non-sensitive aggregate preferences for marketer review.

intelligence_processing.name: Synthetic performance analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares fixed A/B tests, confidence, lift, conversion, revenue, and ROAS while distinguishing scenarios from live results.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-aligned decision preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Frames evidence and review-only options for Marketing Directors and Campaign Managers without authorizing external action.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through a validated Draft agent with four skills, two knowledge files, and no write tools.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot review surface
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports governed review of aggregate segments, campaign concepts, content drafts, and measurement scenarios.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP agent through local chat and UI endpoints with synthetic-only deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Customer Segmentation Overview
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic segment size, spend, orders, lifetime value, churn risk, engagement, and revenue contribution.

management_reporting.name: Draft Campaign Design Portfolio
management_reporting.detail: Presents audience, duration, stages, offer concepts, unsent sequences, benchmarks, and illustrative revenue for approval.

management_reporting.name: Draft Content Personalization Matrix
management_reporting.detail: Presents segment-level hero copy, product ideas, preferred channels, and categories as neutral drafts for review.

management_reporting.name: Marketing Performance Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic A/B test evidence and campaign scenarios with confidence, lift, conversion, revenue, and ROAS limitations.

tools.name: Portable PersonalizedMarketingAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic read-only operations using bundled synthetic data and no credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill conversational package; validated artifacts remain Draft and require marketer approval before publish.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: Provides a collaboration surface for governed review of evidence and recommendations without customer-facing action.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Named as a potential approved read-only CRM or customer-insights seam; no live connector is configured.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Provides the documented human review surface; the package does not send messages or contact customers.

tools.name: Approved read-only customer insights feed
tools.detail: Authorized aggregate production data may replace synthetic records after governance review; current cases remain synthetic.

tools.name: Approved campaign review workflow
tools.detail: Documented approval seam for marketers; it is separate from activation and cannot launch campaigns in the local package.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic aggregate data boundary
supporting_features.detail: Accepts only fixed synthetic planning records and prohibits claims of live customer, campaign, or performance access.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes segmentation, campaign design, content personalization, and performance analysis from persona-language intent.

supporting_features.name: Sensitive-profiling guardrail
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits demographic or sensitive-trait profiling, identity enrichment, and invention of missing customer facts.

supporting_features.name: Explicit marketer approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Keeps audience, copy, offer, timing, and publication decisions behind authorized Marketing Director or Campaign Manager review.

supporting_features.name: No contact or campaign activation
supporting_features.detail: The agent never contacts customers, sends or schedules messages, creates offers, issues rewards, or launches campaigns.

supporting_features.name: Locked case and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Records four passing persona-language cases with required evidence anchors and only the expected marketing tool loaded.

supporting_features.name: Draft package and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Includes source, recipe, skills, knowledge, evidence, and export artifacts while keeping Studio packages unpublished.
